notes.title: League Of Enthusiastic Losers 50% discount: Dec 22, 2021 - Jan 5th, 2022
notes.content: The days have become shorter, and there is nowhere to hide from the cold, which means that now is the time to please yourself or your loved ones with a little piece of summer during the winter holidays. And now you have a great opportunity to do this and celebrate the New Year with Vitya, Volodya and Acorn.

notes.title: League of Enthusiastic Losers is officially released!
notes.content:
[b]Hello! It's me, Yan![/b]
The League of Loser Enthusiasts is finally out! It's time to get to know Vitya and Volodya better, get to know their friends and finally pet Acorn.

This is my first game to be released on Steam. Before that, I only created short cute games. It takes about an hour to complete the game. I hope you enjoy the League of Enthusiastic Losers and continue to support me and my future games. I also thank everyone who supported me in the development of this project. Special thanks to those who funded me on Patreon.

Without my dear friends, the game would not have been able to see the light of day.
